identity.description: Cloudflare, Inc.'s public API (v4) for managing Cloudflare accounts, zones, DNS, tokens, alerting webhooks and other services. Confirmed product: the Cloudflare web performance/security/developer platform, not a different company named Cloudflare.
identity.identity_notes: Sources (developers.cloudflare.com API docs, github.com/cloudflare org) clearly describe the Cloudflare platform. developers.cloudflare.com fetches failed with a TLS certificate error in this session, so developer-doc facts rely on search-result summaries and are flagged unverified.

auth.token_refresh: unknown: API tokens are static until revoked; no refresh flow established
auth.scopes_notes: API tokens carry per-permission groups (user, account, zone scopes); permission reference lives in the fundamentals permissions page. Global API Key (legacy) carries the user's full permissions and is limited to one per user.

access.production_restrictions: No app review established for personal API tokens. Account-owned tokens require API Token Provisioning capability or Super Administrator status, but a developer can use a self-issued user token without that.

write_ops: Create user API tokens via API (requires seed token with API Tokens Write)
api.rate_limits: Official docs (per search summary): 1,200 requests per five-minute period per user, cumulative across dashboard, API keys and tokens; excess returns HTTP 429. Some third-party sites say per token; official reading preferred. Enterprise can request higher limits.
api.limitations: Developer-doc pages were unreachable by direct fetch; breadth and write coverage inferred from API reference and MCP README. GraphQL Analytics API mentioned in rate-limit context but not verified as a separate protocol. Webhook secrets are never returned in responses.
